relationship_to_v0_1.role: mandatory scale sensitivity for the secondary rank-portability question when the outcome-blind matched positive-numeric core is informative

motivation: The completed BIEN positive-only cleaning analysis showed that cross-lineage trait portability can be materially scale-dependent. AusTraits therefore receives a matched raw-versus-log rank-portability sensitivity before any AusTraits memory-loss rho is opened.

matched_positive_numeric_core.starting_population: final outcome-blind AusTraits crossed core after support, semantic, exact-phylogeny, known-truth informativeness and all inherited gates
matched_positive_numeric_core.species_state: source-native species median under the already frozen AusTraits semantic contract
matched_positive_numeric_core.system_log_domain_pass: every eligible species state used by the system is finite and strictly >0
matched_positive_numeric_core.timing: domain screening occurs before any raw or log phylogenetic-memory rho is computed
matched_positive_numeric_core.stable_graph_rule: After domain screening, iteratively remove families represented by fewer than 2 retained traits and traits represented in fewer than 5 retained families until stable.
matched_positive_numeric_core.fail_rule: If the matched core misses any graph minimum, report the raw-versus-log sensitivity unavailable. Do not relax the positivity, degree, family, trait or connectivity rules.

paired_effects.system_set: identical matched positive-numeric family x trait systems for raw and log
paired_effects.log_species_state: natural log of the same strictly positive species median
paired_effects.dissimilarity: absolute difference on the corresponding state scale
paired_effects.separation: all unordered patristic distances on the same S3 or prune-only tree used by the master replication

rank_portability.rank_definition: Within each family and scale, average-rank memory-loss rho and rescale to [0,1], with 0 most conservative and 1 most labile.
rank_portability.held_out_prediction: Predict each held-out family x trait rank using the mean normalized rank of the same trait in all other retained families.
rank_portability.null: Within each family, permute normalized rank values over the observed trait slots, preserving the matched family-trait graph and each family rank distribution.

required_outputs: raw rank-portability gain and p on S3 and prune-only
log rank-portability gain and p on S3 and prune-only
raw-log correlation of trait mean ranks on each tree axis
direct cross-family pair-order reversal probability on raw and log scales
leave-one-trait and leave-one-family gain ranges on both scales

interpretation.scale_robust: The qualitative portability decision is the same on raw and log scales and on both tree axes.
interpretation.scale_sensitive: Raw and log lead to different qualitative portability decisions on either tree axis; report both and do not privilege a scale because of outcome strength.
interpretation.unavailable: The outcome-blind matched core fails graph requirements.

direct_reordering.definition: For each trait pair co-occurring in at least the threshold number of families, calculate the probability that two distinct randomly selected families disagree about which trait has the larger memory-loss rho; report family-pair-count-weighted mean.
direct_reordering.role: effect-size description of lineage-specific re-ranking, not a replacement for the blocked portability test

hard_nonclaims: Do not use observed AusTraits memory effects to decide log eligibility or matched-core membership.
Do not select whichever trait scale produces the stronger result.
Do not alter the v0.1 source-native rank-portability result or the master family-repeatability primary analysis.
Do not treat failure of raw or log portability as proof of zero trait-level structure.
Do not equate phylogenetic-memory rho with evolutionary rate.
